components.css: .ds-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.1fr auto;gap:20px;align-items:baseline;padding:22px 0;border-top:1px solid #0b0b0b;border-bottom:1px solid #d9d8d3;color:#0b0b0b;text-decoration:none;position:relative}.ds-row::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;bottom:-1px;height:2px;width:100%;background:#ff6a13;transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .6s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-row:hover::before,.ds-row:focus-visible::before{transform:scaleX(1)}.ds-row h3{font:900 2.2rem/.95 'Big Shoulders Display','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0}.ds-row p{font:400 14px/1.55 Archivo,system-ui,sans-serif;color:#5f5e59;max-width:40ch;margin:0}.ds-go{transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-row:hover .ds-go{transform:translateX(6px)}.ds-row:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #ff6a13;outline-offset:3px}

narrative.northStar: The Retail Floor with the Lights Off
narrative.overview:
A white retail ground interrupted by black campaign fields, as in a sport-fashion store. Services get the same typographic weight as products: large condensed caps, hairline rules, full-bleed photography. Corners are square, there are no cards and no shadows; structure comes from rules, tonal fields (white, stone, black) and scale.

One orange, the HOLO racket colour, is the only chromatic voice. It marks action and status and is never decoration across a whole surface. Density is generous in section padding and tight in type (display line-height 0.88).
keyCharacteristics: White ground, black campaign fields, stone as the quiet third tone.
Big Shoulders Display 900 uppercase against Archivo; tiny tracked uppercase for navigation and buttons.
Full-bleed photography with a bottom black gradient for headline legibility.
Motion is slow reveal on a single expo-out ease.

rules.name: The One Orange Rule
rules.body: Orange fills mark action or status only. On white, orange as text uses HOLO Orange Ink, never the bright orange.

rules.name: The Two Grounds Rule
rules.body: Every section is either white/stone or black (dark); mixed-tone sections do not exist. Hairlines switch from Line to Ink Line with the ground.

rules.name: The Caps Rule
rules.body: All display type is uppercase Big Shoulders at 900; mixed-case display never appears. Body and labels are never set in the display face except the centre-name input and list names.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never lift. Hover is expressed by a sweep line, colour inversion or a 3.5% image zoom.

dos: Do alternate white and black grounds section by section, with orange reserved for the action or status in each.
Do set every headline, price and number in uppercase Big Shoulders 900 with line-height around 0.88 to 0.95.
Do build lists as rows divided by 1px hairlines rather than as boxed items.
Do keep corners square and depth flat.
Do use HOLO Orange Ink for orange text on white or stone.
Do keep a 2px orange focus outline with 3px offset.
Do keep minimum text at 11px, with prefers-reduced-motion disabling the hero reveal and smooth scroll.
donts: Don't use border-radius, box-shadows or boxed cards.
Don't introduce a second accent colour or tint a whole section orange.
Don't use bright orange (#ff6a13) as small text on white.
Don't set display type in mixed case or in the body face.
Don't use ease curves other than the expo-out (cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)) for reveal and sweep motion.
